Node v24.12.0) on 2026-10-12, from 10:17 to about 16:45 UTC. The machine check printed
`linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz:4cpu:16gib`, which matches the brief, and `node --version` printed
`v24.12.0`. The seat is the implementer-side closing checker of the item's consolidation round C1 (kernel plan R8). It
is not the round's author (`build/M0-a-08-consolidate-1`, L-0458), not an earlier author of the item (L-0153, L-0162,

* Mirrors, all under `scratchpad/waves/check-M0-a-08/`: `after/plat` (a `tar` copy of the tree's `plat/` without
